videos.title: The Thread Under the Scale
videos.quality_note: Force-path discontinuity remains; heel/two-hand clues weakened by portrait crop.

findings.finding: No visible needle movement or earlier high baseline in first second; opening anomaly depends on narration until the 3.5 s flashback.
Portrait crop prevents a clear simultaneous view of both seller hands, weakening the alternative ballast explanation.
Raised heel clue is outside the crop; silent viewers lose the pre-reveal foot hint.
Oval/round gold partly clipped at left; all three pieces can still be counted. Oval is visually round across the sequence.

Thread routing changes: vertical pan-to-hole setup becomes horizontal cylinder pass and a diagonal line apparently attached to the front counter edge at toe reveal. No single continuous force path to the moving pan is demonstrated; a fixed counter attachment would not load the pan.
Cylinder appears at counter height in final background rather than clearly on the under-counter shelf. Confrontation faces cropped.

Brayer and raised type may expose printing explanation early; lettering remains visible at 21–27 despite narration saying it vanished. No reader evidence measures predictability.
Paper dimensions and block nick depiction vary slightly between stills; readable proof and fully black block state are retained after one correction.

videos.title: The Crack That Crossed the Table
videos.quality_note: Shadow reveal readable; approximate shadow geometry and cropped final tabletop proof.

findings.finding: Line has a visibly shadow-like softness and mobile is shown early, so the apparent-crack alternative may not hold. No blinded evidence collected.
Portrait cover reduces tabletop continuation in close-up and removes most final empty-table shadow proof.
Generated hand-shadow geometry is approximate; thin line disappears beyond its darkest silhouette, so exact optical causality is imperfect.
Right vase contour clipped; blue dot, clothing and hairstyle remain consistent. No confirmed prop-state contradiction observed.

videos.title: The Rope He Refused to Pull
videos.quality_note: High flag reveal present; left rope-tail geometry inconsistent and final bag cropped.

findings.finding: Flag tip cropped at right edge; circle and two eyelets still readable.
Blue snip is readable but relation of loose cream tail to the blue knot is not fully resolved in the still.

After flag rises, left running-rope tail still reaches/appears anchored at original bench cleat. A fixed flag on that same rope should carry its free lower tail upward too. The added/remaining rope length makes the demonstrated counterweight state inconsistent.
Floor bag is outside portrait crop; no final decoded frame shows high pennant and floor bag together. Separate close-up and high-flag cuts carry only part of the intended causal proof.
